title: Vela / FinAgent — Current Development State
overallStage: Integrated local prototype; not production ready
confidenceMeaning: Subjective confidence in the stated stage, not percent completion or financial accuracy
testResult: 10 passed test files; 143 passed tests; 0 skipped; 0 failed

features.title: Runtime contracts and shared PI model
features.developed: Zod validates policy, catalog, candidates, checks, complexity, impacts, scores, traces and decisions; shared TypeScript describes PI.
features.verification: E1 foundation tests validate real contracts and catalog.
features.remaining: Full incoming FinancialSnapshot runtime validation is absent; plain string IDs still need membership and ownership checks.

features.title: Versioned prototype policy
features.developed: Central JSON stores profiles, horizons, normalizers, complexity and robustness parameters, explicitly PROTOTYPE_ONLY and empiricallyValidated=false.
features.verification: E1 policy tests pass; source reviewed.
features.remaining: Important thresholds/defaults remain hardcoded in calculator, catalog, checker, AI and browser; empirical/expert calibration is not done.

features.title: Canonical knowledge import and provenance
features.developed: Loads 24 sources, 33 claims, 18 rules, 20 formulas, 26 actions and relationships. Preserves pending statuses; excludes C032/C033 from VERIFIED claims.
features.verification: E1 real package/catalog tests pass.
features.remaining: Background verification is not production approval. All action templates remain PENDING_REVIEW and approved_for_production=NO; loaded objects are mutable cached references.

features.title: Action classes and production/Today gates
features.developed: Separates 12 financial, 11 verification, 3 educational templates. Educational actions cannot be primary Today recommendations; production gate rejects unapproved catalog actions.
features.verification: E1 classification and production/education rejection tests pass.
features.remaining: Catalog presence does not imply a complete action workflow; current catalog enables no approved production actions.

features.title: Formula ownership separation
features.developed: Server monetary calculations and scoring are deterministic; AI supplies classification, suggestions and complexity context. Registry names F001-F020 owners.
features.verification: E1 numerical tests; E4 impact invariance with and without AI complexity.
features.remaining: Browser independently duplicates financial/scoring logic; registry names a nonexistent standalone F010 method. Single formula ownership is not true across the whole app.

features.title: Backend bootstrap and diagnostics
features.developed: Express/TypeScript app, /api routes, 5 MB JSON limit, health/runtime/model diagnostics and catalog delivery.
features.verification: E2 uses actual HTTP app; E7 backend typecheck passes.
features.remaining: Health does not probe external dependencies; CORS is unrestricted; no authentication middleware, job scheduler or operational readiness probe.

features.title: PI ingestion, normalization and version history
features.developed: Accepts seed or snapshot envelope, normalizes top-level user/version IDs, hashes semantic state, encrypts and saves latest plus historical snapshots; PUT triggers review.
features.verification: E2 actual PUT/get trace workflow; E5 version advancement observed.
features.remaining: Property checks/casts replace comprehensive runtime validation. Nested ownership/derived consistency not enforced; every save increases version even for identical input.

features.title: SQLite repositories and restart persistence
features.developed: Node SQLite with WAL/foreign keys, users, snapshots, agents, evaluations, traces, recommendations, feedback, FX, chat and 13 canonical tables.
features.verification: E2 reopens an actual disk database and restores recommendation/feedback.
features.remaining: No migration framework, verified recovery/backup, concurrent deployment testing or Supabase implementation. Disk reopen is not browser/server-process restart coverage.

features.title: Canonical SQLite seeding
features.developed: Seeds canonical tables transactionally with original statuses and exposes table counts.
features.verification: E1/E2 use real store and catalog; source reviewed.
features.remaining: Skips seeding if at least 26 action rows already exist, without validating package/schema version or refreshing changed canonical records.

features.title: Complete backend review pipeline
features.developed: PI update/load → FX → Behavior → Debt → suggestions → Checker/critical coverage → batch complexity → deterministic decision → explanation → persisted Today/trace.
features.verification: E2 real HTTP workflow with mock AI; E1 orchestrator scenarios. E4 separately verifies live AI modules.
features.remaining: No single automated journey combines browser, HTTP, live AI and Feedback; agent working-snapshot changes are not fully merged into saved PI. Evaluation failure finalization is incomplete.

features.title: Agent caching and stale detection
features.developed: Input, policy, and age checks select cached Behavior/Debt outputs or rerun them; dynamic reference date injection supported in reviewWorkflow.
features.verification: Tested in tests/clock-regressions.test.ts (6 tests) and tests/e2e/finagent-14-scenarios.test.ts.
features.remaining: Background expiry cron scheduler; caching invalidation when user updates external profile settings.

features.title: Duplicate evaluation suppression
features.developed: Returns DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED for matching completed snapshot/input/policy/event.
features.verification: E1 scenario 10 passes.
features.remaining: Not a concurrency lock or durable request-id idempotency mechanism; same-version parallel runs remain possible.

features.title: Stale publication guard
features.developed: Compares captured/current PI version before publication, marks superseded run and avoids overwriting Today.
features.verification: E1 scenario 10 simulates version change with onBeforePublish hook.
features.remaining: Not a real parallel HTTP race test; does not protect feedback or Today retrieval from stale state.

features.title: Today snapshot freshness
features.developed: Today returns matched current PI version and decision trace snapshotVersion; fresh evaluation is run synchronously upon PI mutation or version drift.
features.verification: Tested in tests/e2e/feedback-regressions.test.ts (stale feedback rejection, consistent Today refresh).
features.remaining: Background expiry scheduler not yet implemented; active card selection persistence across browser reload without server session.

features.title: Accept lifecycle
features.developed: Records acceptance and feedback without deducting cash or treating acceptance as completion.
features.verification: E1 scenario 11 and E2 actual HTTP pass.
features.remaining: No transition or snapshot guard prevents accepting completed/declined/stale recommendations; browser optimistic state lacks rollback.

features.title: Adjust lifecycle and affordability
features.developed: Requires positive amount, reruns backend Checker against current PI and rejects unsafe amount; safe adjustment is stored.
features.verification: E1 scenario 11 and E2 cover safe/unsafe amounts.
features.remaining: Score, impact, rationale and trace are not recalculated for adjusted amount. Browser retains its local adjustment even if server rejects it.

features.title: Decline and alternative selection
features.developed: Persists decline and forces a new review; generator suppresses declined/completed action IDs for matching snapshot.
features.verification: E1 scenario 11; E2 selects an alternative after decline.
features.remaining: Suppression uses recommendation-ID heuristics and same-snapshot scope, not durable preference learning/cooldown. Browser has no offline retry queue.

features.title: Complete and financial state mutation
features.developed: Atomic, replay-safe Complete transition; enforces checked adjusted amount; performs same-currency cash debits, goal allocation creation, and derived snapshot recalculation in a single SQLite transaction with rollback on failure.
features.verification: Tested in tests/e2e/feedback-regressions.test.ts (12 tests) and tests/e2e/http-workflow-and-security.test.ts.
features.remaining: Non-savings action types (e.g. canceling recurring subscription A015, changing automatic transfer A011) do not yet perform dedicated PI table updates; accepted recommendations do not yet reserve cash across review cycles.

features.title: Recommendation identity handling
features.developed: Feedback looks up requested record, then silently falls back to latest recommendation if not found.
features.verification: Source review; not covered by existing test suite.
features.remaining: Invalid/stale ID should not mutate an unrelated recommendation; requires explicit not-found handling and state checks.

features.title: Live/mock configuration and secret loading
features.developed: Reads provider/model/keys from process or secret env file. Explicit mockMode=false or process FINAGENT_USE_LIVE_LLM=true enables live use; default is mock.
features.verification: E4 explicit live Gemini test passes; E1/E2 use explicit mock clients.
features.remaining: Key presence alone does not enable live mode. No UI shows authoritative AI/mock status; default mock startup must not be called live AI integration.

features.title: Gemini adapter and model rotation
features.developed: Google SDK structured/text calls, rotates aliases, records per-model success/error, attempts next model after raw failures.
features.verification: E4 real Behavior/Suggestions/Evaluation calls pass with liveCallUsed=true and provider=gemini.
features.remaining: Test proves some candidate model succeeded, not that every configured 3.1/3.5 alias is available. No startup model discovery/probe despite D-002.

features.title: Quota/backoff and provider fallback
features.developed: Tracks 404/429 from errors, counters, cooldown, retry-delay/backoff; schema/network errors use deterministic fallback.
features.verification: E1/E2 exercise mock/deterministic paths; source inspected.
features.remaining: No forced 429/network failover test; all-cooled models may still be retried, no persisted/distributed quota or explicit LLM request timeout. No automatic Gemini→OpenAI failover.

features.title: OpenAI-compatible adapter
features.developed: Selected provider calls configurable chat/completions endpoint for text or structured output.
features.verification: Source inspection; E7 backend typecheck. No live OpenAI test found.
features.remaining: An alternative configured provider, not a verified Gemini fallback. Live behavior, timeouts and failure handling remain unverified.

features.title: Behavior classification and recurring detection
features.developed: Keyword/sign rules plus optional LLM categories; preserves user-confirmed classifications, provenance, subscription hints and questions.
features.verification: E4 real Behavior call; E1 orchestration uses deterministic/mock results.
features.remaining: Live prompt includes only first 40 unconfirmed transactions; result IDs not universally checked for membership; no accuracy benchmark; minimized working changes not fully persisted back to PI.

features.title: Debt analysis agent
features.developed: Deterministic interest/payoff metrics, urgency/promo/debt-priority flags; AI writes narrative, not monetary effects.
features.verification: E1 mock orchestration and numerical debt tests; no dedicated live Debt test.
features.remaining: Fixed fallback date, hardcoded 7% middle APR policy, global policy reload, incomplete currency conversion and product/promo model. Narrative numbers not validated.

features.title: Suggestion generation
features.developed: Code builds opportunity pool for A007/A002/A012/A013/A015/A014; AI selects/refines up to three without owning amounts. Critical actions are independently injected.
features.verification: E4 actual live Suggestion call; E1/E2 real downstream checking.
features.remaining: Not free discovery across all 26 actions. Hardcoded 15 minimum, rounding-to-5 and allocation proportions violate full policy centralization. No quality benchmark.

features.title: Single batch T/S/D/O evaluation
features.developed: One logical structured evaluation batch for nonempty valid candidates; factors/rationale/facts/missing info keyed per candidate; code computes F016.
features.verification: E4 verifies live telemetry, factor shape/rationale, candidate count and deterministic financial impact invariance.
features.remaining: One logical call can retry several physical API requests. No cycle-wide physical-call-count assertion; schema clamps invalid values and supplies rationale; fallback EVALUATED factors can conceal uncertainty.

features.title: Backend explanation generation
features.developed: Deterministic translation of trace/decision into human description, effects, policy and source/rule metadata, with 90d/12m figures.
features.verification: E1/E2 real pipeline; source review.
features.remaining: No independent financial recalculation; not a detailed comparison of every alternative. Some default source/rule references inserted rather than proved instance-specific evidence.

features.title: Backend conversational assistant
features.developed: Topic/knowledge mapping, minimized PI/current decision, live-or-fallback answer and persisted message history; returns action/source refs.
features.verification: E1 scenario 14 mock direct Assistant call; no live or HTTP Assistant test.
features.remaining: No conversation history/full trace fed to model; latestTrace unused; citations and numeric prose not verified; no actual financial tool execution or PI edits.

features.title: Latest exchange rates and fallback cache
features.developed: Frankfurter primary/secondary hosts, memory/SQLite caching, request timeout, identity rate, supported list, stale fallback, explicit unavailable rate=0.
features.verification: E1 scenario 13 uses injected FX fetch; numerical FX tests real. No dedicated live FX proof.
features.remaining: Unavailable currencies must remain excluded/flagged. Tests do not establish current external service availability or every multi-currency path.

features.title: Historical exchange rates
features.developed: Dated API/cache retrieval with secondary endpoint and unavailable status.
features.verification: Source/typecheck; no dedicated historical or live HTTP test found.
features.remaining: Historical retrieval also updates latest cache; freshness uses fetchedAt rather than effective rateDate, so old effective rates can appear fresh.

features.title: Identity authentication
features.developed: Missing identity returns 401; supplied header or Bearer text is accepted as identity.
features.verification: E2 tests missing/mismatched IDs; E5 forged victim header and unsigned Bearer both return 200 for victim PI.
features.remaining: No signature/session/OTP/provider validation. Matching client-controlled IDs bypass isolation. Critical blocker for any real multi-user use.

features.title: Repository authorization and user scoping
features.developed: Store and routes compare authenticated/requested user IDs and query by user.
features.verification: E1 scenario14 and E2 mismatch test pass.
features.remaining: Checks work only with a trusted identity, which is absent. Full user isolation is not established by those tests.

features.title: Encryption and key management
features.stage: Implemented prototype (Local transport boundary per D-011)
features.developed: Loopback IPv4 127.0.0.1 transport boundary; rejects nonlocal hosts, DNS-rebinding attacks, and unapproved origins before API routing; allows exact local dev preview CORS. Client-asserted x-user-id header is isolated to local prototype scope.
features.verification: Tested in tests/local-access.test.ts (12 tests) and tests/e2e/http-workflow-and-security.test.ts.
features.remaining: Real multi-user authentication, JWT/session cookies, and identity provider integration are explicitly deferred under D-011/Q-011.

features.title: Encryption coverage and privacy lifecycle
features.developed: Sensitive main PI is encrypted, browser export/reset and backend message persistence exist.
features.verification: Source review; encryption test scope limited to PI.
features.remaining: Agent results, traces, recommendations, notes/chat remain plaintext in SQLite; browser PI is plaintext. No comprehensive retention/deletion/access audit lifecycle.

features.title: PI minimization
features.developed: Removes nickname/account names/institutions/notes/raw rows; regex scrubs email/IBAN/long account numbers; filenames anonymized before model calls.
features.verification: E2 direct PII test and E1 security scenario pass.
features.remaining: Denylist/regex does not guarantee anonymization; IDs, free text, ordinary names/addresses may remain. No exhaustive PII or model-payload audit.

features.title: Prompt-injection defenses
features.developed: Untrusted-data tags neutralize nested tags; prompts identify external data; structured outputs parsed through schemas.
features.verification: Source review; no adversarial red-team suite.
features.remaining: Tags/instructions are basic mitigation, not proof of injection/exfiltration resistance or grounded free-text explanations.

features.title: Server transaction deduplication helper
features.developed: Normalized account/date/amount/currency/text fingerprint and existing/incoming duplicate filtering.
features.verification: Source/typecheck; no dedicated ingestion HTTP test.
features.remaining: No server statement-import endpoint; browser uses a separate deduplication algorithm with different behavior.

features.title: Weight profiles and liquidity hysteresis
features.developed: Liquidity/expensive-debt/goal/balanced precedence, policy weights, liquidity enter/exit hysteresis.
features.verification: E1 profile tests, no-goal scenario5, hysteresis scenario12.
features.remaining: Not empirically calibrated; some snapshot/currency overrides and interest-accruing defaults affect choices.

features.title: Checker, safety and affordability layers

features.verification: E1 numerical/checker/scenario tests pass; E2 unsafe Adjust rejected.

features.title: Critical discovery and ranking

features.verification: E1 candidate affordability tests.

features.verification: E1 scenarios3/8/9; E2 actual trace endpoint.
